Paintings Photos About

With a background in history and photojournalism, Jessica's process is a balance of observation and contemplation. She develops a contextual understanding of her subjects before each shoot, embracing references that reflect contemporary conversations around culture and identity.

The feeling that I'm about to understand something very important is the closest I ever got.
